description: Search the live web (via Tavily) for information not covered by SeqBench's own tools — recent literature, protocols, vendor/reagent info, general facts. Returns a short synthesized answer (if available) plus ranked source snippets with URLs. This does not run any bioinformatics calculation itself; use the dedicated tools for that.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 10).

name: web_search
title: Search the web
